prose_evidence.text_as_printed: This is the affinity I use, I love it. It has a CC / Agro management focus. The most powerful ability is Truce, a complete agro wipe (like Mass Amnesia from Psionicists and that one from Rogues I don't remember the name). You also has a NPC agro wipe that will not work on nameds, but its great for SoD named runs. You also receive a AoE agro reduce, macroing it with the normal cleric agro reducer gives the best agro reducer in game in my opinion (best from the bards cause this reduces for 70%, and bards is only 35%).

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: I used this for very long, its great for leveling your cleric. You will get some new finishers which are more powerful then the normal cleric one. You also get more short term buffs that allows you to reach 20k+ hits (and you, as a cleric, may agree that this is a lot for us). You also get a new stance that increases your damage and block, its good, but the heal reducer is insane, so most of the time you will end up using the normal DPS stance (common to all clerics).

ambiguities.details: Contributor says Truce is a complete wipe, reports a separate unnamed NPC wipe excluding named targets, and estimates combined reductions at 70% versus bard 35%. Unnamed ability identities, stacking and comparison are not resolved.
Adjacent stance modifiers retained under unnamed section-relative subjects; canonical stance names and additive versus multiplicative interpretation unknown.
Printed duration 3000 HP is a dimensionally ambiguous limit; do not reinterpret as seconds or a confirmed absorption pool.

limitations: Contributor Remedio is reporting mechanics and advice; no independent corroboration or historical date established.
Ranges over spell versions are retained as printed, not expanded to inferred rank values.
Anonymous stance subjects are descriptive placeholders, not canonical client entities.
Affinities navigation and author opinions do not establish typed operative facts; linked tables need separate review.
